IB 2027 · SL

Unit 4: Algorithmic Control

Themes B2.3-B2.5 | 4 Weeks (12 Lessons)

Unit overview

How do programs make decisions and repeat tasks efficienty?

This unit covers 5 IB Computer Science sub-topics: B2.3.1, B2.4.1, B2.4.2, B2.4.3, and B2.5.1.

The focus areas are Sequence constructs, Algorithm efficiency (Big O), Linear & Binary Search, Bubble & Selection Sort, and File processing.

Coverage

  • B2.3.1 Sequence constructs
  • B2.4.1 Algorithm efficiency (Big O)
  • B2.4.2 Linear & Binary Search
  • B2.4.3 Bubble & Selection Sort
  • B2.5.1 File processing

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
B2.3.1 Sequence constructs Construct programs implementing correct instruction sequences.
B2.4.1 Algorithm efficiency (Big O) Describe efficiency of algorithms by calculating Big O.
B2.4.2 Linear & Binary Search Construct and trace linear and binary search algorithms.
B2.4.3 Bubble & Selection Sort Construct and trace bubble and selection sort algorithms.
B2.5.1 File processing Construct code to perform file-processing operations.
